generatedAtNote: Regenerate with: node automation/generate-manifest.mjs. 'made' is refreshed from the live toolMetaMap each run; 'pending' is the authored backlog.

requiredFiles.tool.config.js: default export { slug, name, category (string|string[]), description, icon (lucide kebab-case), iconColor (tailwind text-* class), wideWorkspace? }
requiredFiles.entry.jsx: 'use client'; default export that renders ./pages (the interactive widget entrypoint the runtime map imports)
requiredFiles.pages/index.jsx: 'use client'; default export = the actual tool UI. May pull from components/, hooks/, utils/.

buildSpec.styling: Tailwind + CSS variables (--background, --foreground, --card, --border, --primary, --muted, --muted-foreground). Dark mode via [data-theme='dark']. Reuse .heading/.subheading/.description utilities.
buildSpec.icons: icon must be a lucide-static kebab-case name. If it is NOT already in public/icons.svg, run scripts/build-icons.mjs after adding the tool or the icon renders blank.
autoRenderedPageLayout: Interactive tool widget (from entry.jsx, wrapped in an error boundary + recovery UI)
Common use cases (ONLY shown when curated content exists in toolContentOverrides.js)
Related tools (auto-computed by category + keyword overlap, linked to /tools/all/<slug>)
buildSpec.curatedContent: For unique (non-templated) copy + to enable the 'Common use cases' section, add an entry keyed by slug in src/app/tools/toolContentOverrides.js: { intro, useCases: string[], benefits: [title,body][], faqs: [q,a][] }.
registryRebuild: node scripts/build-icons.mjs             # rebuild public/icons.svg (only if new icons)
testGate: npm run build   # must compile; a tool that fails to build/lint is NOT 'made'
optional: render http://localhost:3002/tools/all/<slug> and confirm no error boundary
notes: Registry scripts are NOT part of npm run build — the automation must run them explicitly.
Slugs are kebab-case, lowercase, unique. The folder name IS the slug.
Dev server for this repo runs on http://localhost:3002.

scrapeSources.when: Trigger only when no tools with status 'pending' remain.
scrapeSources.rule: No repetition — every scraped idea must be slug-deduped against ALL existing slugs (made + pending) before being appended as 'pending'.

automation.order: Build the first 50 tools with status 'pending', test, push, then mark them 'made' and re-run.
automation.doneWhen: No 'pending' tools remain AND scrape sources yield no new non-duplicate ideas.
